retirement_intent: Extract or deliberately reject every useful organ, verify canonical replacements, then decommission and delete the exact ShadowBroker product resources.

reuse_decisions.reason: QazStack had no equivalent multiplicity, freshness, null-rate and stale-state cutover receipt; the extracted contract is provider-neutral and contains no record identifiers or payloads.

QazStack Geo had no equivalent outward-coarsening contract. The extracted pure helpers omit Shadow's product radius and UI, fail closed on invalid coordinates, and explicitly describe precision reduction as data minimisation rather than anonymisation.
QazStack already owns early-warning, drift, graph, scenario and calibration contracts; Shadow weights, cases, region heuristics and operator actions are product policy rather than a shared primitive.
QazStack already owns versioned series, event batches and deterministic snapshot diffs, so the Shadow store and UI adapter must be retired after successor adoption.
QazStack already verifies canonical bytes, rotated keys, clock skew and replay rejection; only recipient-native rotation and old-secret rejection evidence is required.

AVDS already provides freshness, source policy and health, operational evidence, release proof and map layer controls. The Shadow rail, sheet and timeline remain candidates only after a second consumer and exact catalog gap.

module_inventory.classification_policy: First matching rule is the primary disposition. The immutable donor Git tree, not the mutable checkout, is the inventory authority.
